121 PM PDT Tue Mar 17 2026

...EXTREME HEAT WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 PM PDT FRIDAY...

* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures between
  96 and 104 expected.

* WHERE...Most valley, lower mountain, and inland coastal areas of
  southwest California.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...There is a high risk for dangerous heat illness for
  anyone, especially for the very young, the very old, those without
  air conditioning, and those active outdoors.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Warm overnight low temperatures will
  contribute to the heat risk, especially in the mountain and
  foothill locations.

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.
